outcome: Analysts get triage context and a starting position gathered automatically, freeing time for judgement calls only a person can make.
overview: Every bank security team in the region is short of analysts, and the work that consumes them is the repetitive first hour of an investigation rather than the interesting part. Charlotte AI performs that triage work within the platform: summarising a detection, gathering context, and proposing a disposition for a human to accept or reject. The governance question is more interesting than the technology one — what an assistant is permitted to conclude, and what a human must still decide, has to be written down before it is switched on.

benefits.text: Routine triage context is gathered automatically rather than by an analyst repeating lookups
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Time saved should be measured per detection class against a pre-deployment baseline; an aggregate figure hides where it did and did not help

benefits.text: A proposed disposition gives an analyst a starting position rather than a blank case
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. A proposed disposition creates anchoring risk: analysts may accept it more readily than they would form it, and sampling for that is part of the governance

benefits.text: The capability is part of the platform rather than an integration to maintain
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. It is also tied to the platform, so the capability does not transfer if the platform is replaced, and it is not portable to another vendor’s detection platform

residency: Detection data is processed by the assistant within the vendor tenant; for a regulated bank the position on automated processing of security data is a governance question before a technical one

notFor.situation: A team not already on this vendor’s detection platform
notFor.why: The capability operates on that platform’s data and does not transfer

notFor.situation: An organisation without a written position on what an assistant may conclude
notFor.why: The governance question decides whether the output can be relied on, and it is not a technical setting

scope:
Model: Redington solutions engineering with an accredited CrowdStrike implementation partner · Duration: 4–8 weeks to enablement with baseline and sampling in place
Support model: Vendor subscription support; Redington coordinates the vendor case. A quarterly review is recommended given the pace of change in this capability class.
1) Baseline — triage time and disposition quality measured per detection class before enablement
2) Govern — written action boundary agreed, sampling process designed
3) Enable — capability switched on within the boundary
4) Sample and hand over — first sampling cycle completed, operating model handed over
deliverables: The assistant proposes rather than applies, verified against the written boundary
Analyst decisions are recorded alongside the proposal for every triaged detection
The first sampling cycle reports agreement rate and an anchoring assessment separately
effort: 4–8 weeks to enablement with baseline and sampling in place
languages: English delivery; Arabic executive materials on request
